name: Strangler Fig Pattern
forces_resolved: Incremental, low-risk migration of legacy monolith to microservices or modern architecture
Continuous delivery of business value during migration: new features go to new services immediately
forces_unresolved: Temporary increase in system architectural complexity while both legacy and new systems run in parallel
Routing proxy overhead and ongoing data synchronization between legacy and new databases
Risk of stalled migration leaving the system in a perpetual hybrid state
applicability_conditions: Modernizing large, mission-critical legacy monoliths where downtime or rewrite failure is unacceptable
Teams needing to carve out high-value or high-scale capabilities one by one
Organizations transitioning to cloud-native architectures incrementally
anti_requisites: Greenfield new software applications with no legacy codebase
Small codebases (< 10,000 LOC) where a direct refactor is cheaper and faster
Teams lacking API gateway / reverse proxy routing infrastructure
